visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large stainless steel pot is being stirred with a metal ladle. Inside, dozens of small, colorful glutinous rice balls (tangyuan) in shades of white, yellow, pink, and blue bob in a clear, simmering liquid. (2) The scene shifts to a bright indoor setting where several branded takeaway paper bowls are arranged. One bowl features large white tangyuan, chunks of taro, and yellow sweet potato balls, while another in the background contains a soft-boiled egg and green vegetables in broth. (3) A yellow plastic spoon lifts a large, white savory tangyuan that has been bitten into, revealing a dark, seasoned meat filling. The background shows a bowl of noodles with sliced green loofah. (4) An outdoor shot of the shop front shows two female customers standing at the ordering counter under a yellow and white striped awning. One customer is wearing a pink motorcycle helmet and a purple jacket. (5) Back to a close-up, noodles are being lifted from a bowl of soup with a pair of chopsticks, showing the steam rising and the inclusion of tangyuan and green vegetables. (6) A dessert bowl is presented, filled with shaved ice and topped with large stuffed tangyuan, red beans, taro cubes, and translucent yellow jelly (fen-guo). (7) A spoon splits open a large tangyuan on top of red bean ice, revealing a dark, viscous black sesame filling. (8) Small, multicolored tangyuan are scooped from a metal tray and placed into a bowl of smooth, white tofu pudding (douhua), followed by a pour of amber-colored syrup. (9) A close-up shows a ladle scooping thick, dark red bean and purple rice porridge into a bowl. (10) The final sequence shows the interior of the shop with light wood furniture and menu boards, ending with a graphic overlay displaying the shop's name, address, and social media branding.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a soft drum beat. A male narrator introduces the video with an energetic and friendly tone, speaking clearly in Mandarin Chinese. (2) As the visuals transition between various dishes, a subtle 'pop' sound effect highlights a text overlay. The narrator maintains a steady, fast-paced speech rate, describing the textures of the tangyuan and the savory nature of the noodles. (3) The background music continues consistently throughout, providing a positive, upbeat atmosphere. The sound of liquid being scooped is briefly audible but remains very quiet under the narration. (4) The narrator concludes with an invitation to visit the shop, his voice rising in pitch at the end for a friendly farewell, as the music fades out alongside the closing branded graphic.
